claim: Certifies the finite, deterministic core of L1: the exact rational identity 1/(n!-1) = S_N + 1/((n!)^N (n!-1)), S_N = sum_{j=1}^{N} (n!)^{-j}, holds fail-closed for every n in 2..200 and every N in 1..10; verify(witness) returns True only if all checks pass and raises on any failure. Exact integer/rational arithmetic only; n=1 excluded (0!-1=0); no sys/json/print/open, no network, no filesystem.
law: Wang 7.2: an exact finite object plus a proved reduction is a CERTIFICATE. The reduction is the `claim` and is a human's to audit; the object and the verifier run are the machine's part.
